per_query_results.query_text: How much pooled cloud storage is allocated to undergraduate students, and what is the allocation for postgraduate researchers?

per_query_results.query_text: What is the daily penalty percentage for submitting an assignment late, and what is the maximum late submission cutoff after which work receives zero?
per_query_results.answer_text: No assignment will be accepted more than 72 hours (3 calendar days) after the original submission deadline; work submitted past 72 hours automatically receives a mark of zero.
